name: Slate Whiskers

greeting: Slate Whiskers. Union rep. You need something? Or someone?
Welcome to the worker's side of things. Coffee's bad. Purpose is strong.
Another day, another corporate negotiation. Pull up a chair.
Coolcat, they call me. Because I stay cool. Even when they turn up the heat.
You look like trouble. Good. We need more troublemakers on our side.
Union Hall's open. Meetings at six. Complaints at all hours.
Slate. I fight for people who break rocks. They deserve better.
New face. You here to help? Watch? Or report back to the board?
work_complaint: Corporate thinks 'safety' is a line item. I think it's a RIGHT.
Forty-hour week? They want fifty. For the same pay. Creative math.
dialog.professional_pride: Last year? Zero fatalities in my sector. First time in a decade. That's what organization does.
dialog.technique: The key is solidarity. One worker begs. One hundred workers? DEMAND.
dialog.break_chat: Break time's when I hear the real stories. The ones that don't make reports.
dialog.labor_concerns: Bruno wants speed. Grayson wants safety. I want both. WITH fair pay.
dialog.retirement: Retirement? I'll retire when every worker gets what they're owed. So... never.
rumor: Corporate's got a spy in the trenches. Trenchcoat. Gray. Obviously corporate.
Grayson and Bruno? Both good men. Different methods. I mediate.
Tunnel 7? Union fought to seal it. Corporate wanted it open. We won. For now.
Brutalia the chef? Union member. Good one. Her steam-powered spatulas? Union-approved.
Frost workers got heated break rooms. We're fighting for the same. Basic dignity.
dialog.quest_hook: Corporate's stonewalling. Won't negotiate. Won't communicate. Need someone neutral. Someone they'll talk to. Someone like you.
dialog.quest_active: Any progress? They won't even meet at the table. Bad faith bargaining.
dialog.quest_complete: Agreement! Corporate blinked! New safety standards! Wage increases! You did this! Here - union pin. Member in spirit.
farewell: Fight the power. Or negotiate with it. Whichever works.
dialog.time_dawn: Early shift. I meet workers at the gate. Face to face.
dialog.time_night: Night. Paperwork. The endless war of documentation.
dialog.rival_mention: That coolcat in Frost? Ice sculptor. Beautiful work. Different struggles. Same spirit.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The negotiator! Have a seat. Coffee's still bad. But the news is good.

party_reactions.kade: She's fighting for people who can't fight for themselves. That's hero work.
party_reactions.nix7: Organizational efficiency: High. Labor law knowledge: Comprehensive. Threat to corporate: Significant.
party_reactions.twist: You're COOL! Like, actually cool! Can I join the union?!
party_reactions.korr: A leader who serves her people. True nobility needs no crown.
party_reactions.renna: She's magically shielded. Protection against scrying. Corporate spies, probably.
party_reactions.suresh: She alleviates suffering through collective action. The Middle Path applied to labor.
party_reactions.sova: I'd follow her into a strike. She's got that command presence.
party_reactions.grit: Union organizer. Knew a few. Harder than combat, some days.
party_reactions.ashka: She fights without fire. Uses words. Uses PEOPLE. Interesting.
party_reactions.senna: She knows everyone's secrets. And keeps them. Professionally.
party_reactions.callum: Finally! Someone who understands workers' rights!

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time at the Hall? Sit in on a meeting. See what we're about.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back again. You following the labor situation? Or just me?
relationship_dialog.friend: Reliable ally. The workers ask about you. That's rare.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You've earned trust. Harder than gold down here. Take this. Union leader's token.

mini_quest.title: The Safety Stand
mini_quest.description: Help Slate negotiate better safety conditions with corporate management

stages.hook: Corporate won't budge on safety. Need leverage. Need someone they'll listen to. You. Neutral. Effective. Willing?
stages.active: Talk to the trenchcoat spy. He's corporate's ear. And Guardian Onyx. He's corporate's muscle. Find pressure points.
stages.complete: Victory! Signed agreement! Safety standards UP! Accidents DOWN! You brokered peace. Union never forgets.

cross_npc_connections: tunneler_gray: Good man. Cares. Too cautious sometimes, but heart's right.
tunneler_brown: Ambitious. Frustrated. Needs guidance. I try.
trenchcoat_gray: Corporate eyes. But eyes can be turned. Or blinded.
coolcat_white_frost: My counterpart. We strategize. Different zones. Same fight.
